clean_task.detail: An independently authored 5-point Jacobi task ran through the typed container Provider in the digest-pinned gcc 13.2.0 image. Correctness held: per-step trajectory equivalence over sixteen steps was exact, the linearity identity held to 1.7e-16, and the undefined-behaviour/bounds, address and thread sanitizer runs over the two-thread barrier decomposition were clean. Performance did not: the typed job receives the whole node in its affinity mask with no CPU binding, and under that placement the two-thread candidate reached only 0.96x of its own serial baseline, below the 1.05x gate. The same binary reached 1.68x in a CPU-bound four-core allocation, so the shortfall is thread placement rather than the candidate. This clean task is therefore unsatisfied until the typed path binds CPUs. No imported attachment executed.

provider_portability.detail: The verified Provider snapshot contains fewer than two Provider sets satisfying every required capability; portability is not claimed as passed.
